verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents a first-party port-in flow in the Admin console: you enter up to 1000 landline/VoIP numbers and choose an activation date, and Google runs ports per losing-carrier account/BTN. In non-US countries it supplies an authorization template to fill in matching the port order, and community users report porting numbers into GV. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the losing-carrier account fields collected (account number, PIN, billing address), a US letter-of-authorization/e-signature step, and port status tracking.
